name: sikstack
description: A phase-and-slice workflow for Claude Code: plan a phase, run each slice on its own executor, review it, and walk it before it lands. State lives in your repo's hidden .sikstack/ folder; run /sikstack:setup once per machine, then /sikstack:sik-mode in any repo.

email.title: Email
email.description: The address /sikstack:setup registers this install under (one setup per machine); sign-in later claims the install with it.
